summary: Sets a per-wheel gear selection inside a multi-dimensional indexed structure (index v5 = (a3 + 11*a2) << 6 into a per-driver/per-wheel matrix). If a4 > 0 clamps the new gear to a4 or maxGear-1 and writes it to slot+20; if a4 <= 0 zeroes the previous value at index+196. When the enable byte this+0x19A5 is non-zero, runs TrackConfig and fires EventTriggerOnStateChange into a related row. TrackConfig runs again unconditionally. If the new slot+20 gear differs from the saved value, sets the dirty flags this+0x19A4 and this+0x0 to 1. Returns the previously saved gear value. Invoked by IndexedCallWith1Increment per gear slot.

local_names.a2: selector dimension (driver/wheel index) used in the row index
local_names.a3: secondary index dimension (wheel) used in the row index
local_names.a4: requested gear value; <=0 clears the gear, >0 clamps to the valid range
local_names.v11: previously saved gear value at index v5 + 196

operations.description: v5 = (a3 + 11*a2) << 6: compute the row index into the per-driver/per-wheel matrix; v7 = &this[v5 + 176] is the slot base.
v11 = *(DWORD*)&this[v5 + 196]: read and save the previously selected gear value.
Positive-gear path: if a4 > 0, read max gear *(v5+192); if a4 < max write a4 to slot+20, otherwise write max-1, clamping the gear into the valid range.
Clear path: if a4 <= 0, write 0 into the saved-gear slot at index v5 + 196.
Enable guard: only when the byte this+0x19A5 (index 6565) is non-zero do the track-config and event dispatch run.
TrackConfig(this, a2, a3) runs inside the enable guard.
EventTriggerOnStateChange(this, v7, &this[704*v9 + 176 + 64*a3]) fires when the enable byte is set; v9 is a selector index derived from a2 (a2==0 -> 1, a2==1 -> 0, a2==2 -> 2).
TrackConfig(this, a2, a3) runs again unconditionally after the event block.
If the new gear at slot+20 differs from the saved v11, mark the change: set this+0x19A4 (index 6564) to 1 and this+0x0 to 1.
Return the previously saved gear value v11; the function is called by IndexedCallWith1Increment (00467340).

unresolved: The matrix layout (11 rows, a2 vs a3 semantics, stride 64) is inferred from the index arithmetic only; row/driver meaning is unconfirmed.
The v9 selector mapping and the target row of EventTriggerOnStateChange (704*v9 + 176 + 64*a3) are unconfirmed.
Owner object identity and the meaning of the enable byte this+0x19A5 are not established by the packet.
